description: `start --reseed` rewrites a missing or stale seed and re-points the live Nexus, printing the Python success message. Repeating it with a current seed skips both the rewrite and re-point. Separate fake Herdr call logs assert that neither invocation creates another workspace or agent, and that only the first sends a prompt. Rust-only stateful fake Herdr lifecycle scenario (herdr_seed).

home.config_toml:
[accounts.nexus-seat]
kind = "claude"
config_dir_var = "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR"
config_dir = "{{DIR:claude-home}}"
pool = "claude:test"
interactive = true
command = "claude-interactive"

[accounts.worker]
kind = "codex"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home}}"
pool = "codex:test"
command = "codex"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"

[projects.sandbox.chains]
explorer = ["worker"]
fixer = ["worker"]
reviewer = ["worker"]

.multiverse/orchestrator.md.regex: \| Builder \| worker \|[\s\S]*\| Critic \| worker \|[\s\S]*\| Scout \| worker \|[\s\S]*- Cross-vendor review required for:
